title: TJÄRBLOMSTER bedspread
description: TJÄRBLOMSTER bedspread, gray, 59x83" This bedspread is lightweight and super-soft and works perfectly as an extra layer of warmth and snugness when you need it - but be aware, it might make getting out of bed just a little bit harder. features: The bedspread fits 35⅜" beds with approx. 12" drop on each side.
